label: L5_ADAPTED_GEMINI_BTC15M_V2
notes: L5_ADAPTED_GEMINI_BTC15M_V2 corrects exactly one field of L5_ADAPTED_GEMINI_CRYPTO@62d004d80b4af8b9: TTE_policy. Every other field is that lane's, byte for byte, and L5_ADAPTED_GEMINI_CRYPTO is preserved unchanged as the control.

TTE_policy.name: TTE_policy
TTE_policy.prior_evidence: CORRECTION to L5_ADAPTED_GEMINI_CRYPTO.TTE_policy, which was {'quote_between_tte_s': [0, 300]}. GEMINI_CRYPTO quotes only tte <= 300. That 300 is the length of a Gemini BTC5m contract: OURS_ADAPTED, never measured from L5, chosen for the 5-minute cohort and then inherited unchanged when the same lane was bound to BTC15m (TTE_PROVENANCE_1.md). TTE_policy is instrument-specific precisely because the number is a window length, and a Gemini BTC15m window is 900s -- so the instrument rule, applied to THIS instrument, gives 900. L5's own measured TTE_policy on a 900s window is [0, 900], which is the same number arrived at independently. L5 BTC15m fills, 63,569 deduped across 527 windows: 560 of 626 OPEN fills (89.5%) land at tte 600-900, 46 at 300-600, and NONE below tte 60 -- under [0, 300] the clone is present only for the 3.2% tail in which L5 has stopped opening. Paired observed-price replay over 96 identical Gemini BTC15m contracts: a fee-positive complement is price-observable in 28 contracts under [300, 900] against 12 under [0, 300]; the discordant pairs split 22 to 6 (two-sided sign test p=0.0037); and 38 of the 96 contracts have NO prints whatsoever inside [0, 300]. See L5_TTE_SEGMENTS_1.md and analysis/gemini/early_15m_observed*.json. NOT CHANGED: side selection, tick_offsets, rung_count, both_sides_policy, sequential inventory state, EXTEND/COMPLETE classification, base_parent_qty, secondary_rung_qty, max_residual, NO_NEW_OPEN_EXTEND_TTE_S (60s), WITHDRAW_ALL_TTE_S (30s), MAX_ACTIONS (12). SHADOW ONLY. Not authorized for any live path, and it carries no live-progression gate. It is run ALONGSIDE the lane it corrects so the two decision records can be compared on one tape.
